Student Found Dead in Ranchi Hostel, Police Investigate

A postgraduate student was found dead in a hostel at BIT Mesra in Ranchi. Police were alerted late at night and arrived at the scene to begin an investigation. While no suicide note was found, a diary was recovered from the room. Some entries in the diary reportedly mention family-related difficulties, according to police. The body was taken into custody for further examination.
